description: Reusable Codex skills for independent app development and operations.

interface.shortDescription: 从需求调研到 Android 开发、商店发布与持续迭代。
interface.longDescription: Magic App Dev provides reusable workflows for demand research, product planning, design approval, paired Android/legal workspace creation, implementation, whole-release review and repair, device QA, mainline integration, first Google Play launch and updates, product analytics, stability diagnosis and iteration outcome verification. Release review reconciles cumulative requirements, feature interactions, architecture and evidence; project facts remain app-owned and publication remains owner-controlled by default.
defaultPrompt: 判断当前产品阶段并完成这次开发或迭代。
Google Play 上架前全盘审查本版本，修复有证据的问题并清理确定过时的内容，验证发布条件，将不确定项汇总让我决定。
准备 Google Play 发版并评估商店更新，停在我送审之前。
